tools.description: Lists every BaseEdge Labs trading strategy for TradingView: its strategy_id, name, page on baseedgelabs.ai, whether it is free or paid, how many presets it has and, when signed in, whether this account holds a license for it. The response is small: one short row per strategy, no presets. It is the starting point for what exists; list_presets returns the presets themselves. Takes no inputs. Read-only.
tools.name: list_strategies
tools.title: List strategies

tools.description: Finds presets: saved settings of a strategy for one instrument and chart timeframe. Each result has its preset_id, strategy, instrument, timeframe, a plain summary and, where published, its TradingView Strategy Tester results. It is the tool for finding and comparing presets; every filter is optional and filters combine, and with none it returns every preset available. Results are summaries without input values: get_preset returns one preset's every input, export_preset its files. Covers the free strategies' presets, plus a paid strategy's presets when the signed-in account holds its license. For a paid strategy without a license it returns no presets and a note with the strategy's page. Read-only.

instrument.description: Optional. A symbol or part of one, for example MNQ, MGC, XAUUSD or US100

strategy.description: Optional. A strategy_id or strategy name, matched ignoring case, spaces and dashes, for example tokyo-drift or Tokyo Drift

timeframe.description: Optional. A chart timeframe in minutes, for example 5m or 5 minutes

tools.name: list_presets
tools.title: List presets

tools.description: Returns one preset in full: its summary and Strategy Tester results, the Strategy Tester properties to set (initial capital, commission, slippage), its contracts, the strategy's page, and every input value keyed by its exact label on the TradingView chart. It is the tool for explaining a preset's settings or results, or setting it up by hand; list_presets finds presets and export_preset returns their files. Returns an error message if the preset_id is unknown or not available to this account. Read-only.

preset_id.description: The preset_id of one preset, as returned by list_presets

tools.name: get_preset
tools.title: Get a preset

tools.description: Returns download links to one preset's two files, each with import steps. "tradingview": a flat settings file keyed by input label, for TradingView's Load Parameters. "hypernull": the HyperNull browser extension's preset file (name, strategy, instrument and timeframe included). The response is { preset_id, title, hypernull: { url, how_to_import }, tradingview: { url, how_to_import } }. It is the tool for loading a preset onto a chart; get_preset returns the values for reading or explaining. Links from the signed-in server expire after 15 minutes and re-check the license; links from the public server do not expire. Read-only.

preset_id.description: The preset_id of one preset, as returned by list_presets

tools.title: Export a preset
